intent: Report the share of respondents who identify as cat people from the provided data.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Report the share of respondents who identify as cat people.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: The share of respondents who identify as cat people is 11.5%.

optional_valid: Displaying the 11.5% value as a labeled partial ring/gauge segment.
unsupported_to_avoid: Deriving or reporting the complement (88.5%) as the requested share.
Treating the value as an absolute count of respondents.
Adding other sectors or categories not present in the data.
review_notes: Single-row partial ring/gauge; the required analytical fact is the gauge value itself.
No complement unit is required because the intent asks only for the cat-people share.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
